name: ozack
description: Ozack Main Application runner for Chat and Dispatch (Frontend & Backend)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "CHAT-BE,CHAT-FE,DISPATCH-BE,DISPATCH-FE" -c "magenta.bold,cyan.bold,green.bold,yellow.bold" "npm --prefix Chat/backend run dev" "npm --prefix Chat/frontend run dev" "npm --prefix Dispatch/backend run dev" "npm --prefix Dispatch/frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:chat: concurrently -n "CHAT-BE,CHAT-FE" -c "magenta.bold,cyan.bold" "npm --prefix Chat/backend run dev" "npm --prefix Chat/frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:dispatch: concurrently -n "DISPATCH-BE,DISPATCH-FE" -c "green.bold,yellow.bold" "npm --prefix Dispatch/backend run dev" "npm --prefix Dispatch/frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix Chat/backend && npm install --prefix Chat/frontend && npm install --prefix Dispatch/backend && npm install --prefix Dispatch/frontend
